eyebrow: Gentle to moderate · for an active routine
heroLead: Energising 1:1 sessions of flowing movement, scaled to your fitness and built around your routine, with sustainable habits you can actually keep. Practised alongside your doctor's guidance.
empathyLabel: You don't have to do this alone
empathyText: Crash plans don't last. Yoga can be an enjoyable, sustainable part of your week, building an active routine and habits you can actually keep, at your own pace.

faqs.q: How much weight will I lose?
faqs.a: We don't promise numbers. Yoga supports an active, sustainable routine, and steady habits are what make the difference over time.

faqs.q: Is yoga enough on its own?
faqs.a: It's a great, sustainable part of the picture. Healthy eating and your doctor's guidance matter too.

faqs.q: I'm a beginner and not very fit. Can I keep up?
faqs.a: Yes. Intensity is matched to you with modifications, and we build gradually so every level feels achievable.

faqs.q: Should I check with a doctor first?
faqs.a: Please do if you're inactive or have heart, blood-pressure, or joint concerns, and tell your teacher so we can plan around it.
Consistency beats intensity. Your teacher will suggest a sustainable rhythm you can keep.

safetyTitle: Yoga supports your care, it doesn't replace it
safetyText: These sessions support your overall wellbeing and are practised alongside professional medical care. They are not a substitute for diagnosis, treatment, or medication. Please tell your teacher about any conditions or symptoms so they can adapt your session safely, and keep your doctor in the loop.
metaDescription: Energising 1:1 yoga scaled to your fitness, with sustainable flows and healthy habits that support an active routine and steady, lasting progress. First session free.
